    StartersVermont maple cheddar apple toastiesAged cheddar, thin apple and maple butter on toasted sourdoughHow to make it50g butter1 tbsp maple syrup2 crisp apples8 slices of sourdough250g aged cheddarwholegrain mustard, to tasteMix the soft butter with the maple syrup.Core the crisp apples and slice very thin.Fill the slices of sourdough with the sliced aged cheddar and the apple, spreading a little wholegrain mustard inside.Brush the outsides with the maple butter.Cook in a pan over medium-low heat 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melting.Cut into triangles.Shenanigans loaded cheese friesCrisp fries under cheddar sauce, bacon, pickled jalapeño, sour creamHow to make it1kg frozen thick-cut fries150g diced bacon20g butter1 tbsp plain flour250ml milk150g cheddar1 jar pickled jalapeños2 spring onions150g sour creamBake the frozen thick-cut fries at 220°C for 25 minutes until crisp.Fry the diced bacon until crisp.Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and simmer 2 minutes, then stir in the grated cheddar until smooth.Pile the fries on a platter, pour over the cheese sauce and top with bacon, sliced pickled jalapeños and spring onion.Serve with the sour cream.Buffalo chicken tenders with ranchMeow. Spoon into a pie dish, cover with pastry and brush with egg.Bake until golden.Boil the beans and toss with the rest of the butter.SweetsSyrup-chug maple bacon pancakesButtermilk pancakes with crisp bacon, whipped butter and maple syrupHow to make it300g self-raising flour2 tbsp sugar2 eggs400ml buttermilk150g butter8 bacon rashers200ml maple syrupWhisk the self-raising flour, the sugar, the eggs, the buttermilk and the melted butter into a thick batter.Grill the bacon rashers until crisp.Cook ladles of batter in a buttered pan over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden and risen.Beat the soft butter until fluffy.Stack the pancakes per plate with bacon and a spoon of butter, and pour over warm maple syrup.DrinksHomemade spiced colaCitrus and spice cola syrup topped with soda water over iceHow to make it1 orange2 limes1 lemon1 cinnamon stickcoriander seeds, to taste1 star anise200g sugarvanilla extract, to taste1 L soda water4 cups icePut the zest of the orange, the lime and the lemon in a saucepan with the cinnamon stick, a little coriander seeds, the star anise and the water.Simmer 10 minutes.Melt the sugar until dark amber, carefully pour in the spiced water and stir until smooth.Add the vanilla and the juice of the lime.Strain and cool.Mix the syrup with the soda water in a 1 litre jug full of ice.Vermont maple lemonadeChug it, but not like the syrup.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
